_doc: Every workflow step that calls the GitHub API with the repository's GITHUB_TOKEN (1,000 REST requests an hour, shared by every workflow), as `workflow file: step name` -> why it may, and its calls per run where known.

scripts/ci/github_token_budget_lint.py warns (never fails) on a step that spends the token and is not here. Prefer git (ls-remote, fetch --filter=blob:none), the event payload or an App token over a new line.
"baseline 2026-11-04" marks a step that was already there when this file started; replace it with a reason when you touch the step.
